steps.title: Prepare Equipment and Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary equipment and bring reagents to the required temperatures.

substeps.instruction: Bring RNAClean XP (A63987) to room temperature.
Ensure a chilling block for 384-well plates is at -20 °C.
Prepare the program on a 384 thermal cycler.

steps.title: RNA Sample Cleanup
steps.instruction: Concentrate the RNA samples using RNAClean XP beads.

substeps.instruction: Thaw RNA samples on ice (up to 2 plates of 96 samples).
Add RNAClean XP beads at a 1.8 ratio to all RNA samples.
Incubate at room temperature for 00:05:00.
Place the plate on a magnet and allow beads to separate for 00:08:00.
Remove supernatant and set aside in a new 96-well plate.
Wash beads by adding 200 µL 80% ethanol; incubate for 00:00:30.
Remove 80% ethanol.
Repeat the ethanol wash (add 200 µL 80% ethanol, incubate 00:00:30, then remove).
Briefly spin the plate and remove any remaining ethanol with fresh tips.
Remove plates from magnet and resuspend beads in 3 µL EB.
Incubate beads in EB for 00:05:00 at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare Oligo Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the SMART Pico Oligos Mix v2 while the RNA is eluting.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 384-well plate containing 0.25 µL SMART Pico Oligos Mix v2 (e.g., using a Labcyte Echo 525).

steps.title: RNA Elution and Oligo Mixing
steps.instruction: Elute the RNA and combine it with the Oligo Mix.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL 80% ethanol to wash beads; incubate for 00:00:30.
Remove 80% ethanol.
Place the RNA plate on the magnet and allow beads to separate for 00:02:00.
Transfer 2 µL of sample into the plate containing 0.25 µL SMART Pico Oligos Mix v2.
Mix with PlateMaster and quickly spin down the plate.

steps.title: Denaturation and First Strand Synthesis
steps.instruction: Perform thermal denaturation and first-strand reverse transcription.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the RNA and SMART Pico Oligos Mix v2 at 72 °C for 00:03:00 in the thermocycler.
Immediately move samples to the chilling block for 00:02:00.
Prepare First Strand reverse transcription mastermix (no. reactions + 10%).
Add 2.75 µL of MasterMix to each sample, mix by pipetting, and spin down the plate.
Incubate in the pre-heated thermocycler: 42 °C for 01:30:00, then 70 °C for 00:10:00, followed by a 4 °C hold.

steps.title: Second Strand Amplification
steps.instruction: Perform second strand amplification via PCR.

substeps.instruction: Prepare thermocycler in a post-PCR area.
Set up and run the PCR (details as per pre-set program).
Mix by pipetting, spin down the plate, and start PCR.

steps.title: Library Pooling and Cleanup
steps.instruction: Pool the libraries and perform size selection using Ampure XP beads.

substeps.instruction: Pool equal volumes of each sample to be captured together into a 1.5 ml LoBind tube (aim for a final pool >> 500 ng; typically 3 µL per sample for a 96-plex).
Accurately measure the volume of the pool with a pipette.
Add 0.68x Ampure XP (or 0.8x for low-quality RNA) to each pool.
Mix thoroughly by pipetting or vortexing.
Incubate for 00:05:00 at room temperature.
Transfer tubes to magnet and incubate for 00:08:00.
Remove and keep supernatant in a clean tube (leave <5 µL behind to avoid bead carryover).
Wash beads with 200 µL 80% ethanol; leave for 00:00:30.
Remove and discard the supernatant.
Centrifuge briefly and remove residual ethanol with a P10 or P20 pipette.
Air dry beads until they start to crack.
Resuspend beads in a volume of EB equal to or less than the starting pool volume.
Mix by pipetting or vortexing (if vortexing, wait 00:02:00 before centrifuging).
Transfer the clean eluant to a fresh 1.5 ml LoBind tube.

steps.title: Library Quality Control
steps.instruction: Quantify and check the size of the pooled libraries.

substeps.instruction: Quantify the pool using Qubit dsDNA HS Assay Kit (Cat#: Q32854).
Check library size on an Agilent Tapestation with High Sensitivity D1000 Screen Tapes assay (Cat#: 5067-5584).
Bring forward 500 ng from each pool for capture and store the remainder.

steps.title: Hybridization Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the probes and denature the DNA libraries.

substeps.instruction: Defrost xGen Lockdown Probes (IDT) on ice from -20 °C.
Dry down the tube contents (libraries + COT Human DNA + Blocking Oligos) using a high-temperature SpeedVac.
Vortex for 00:00:10 and spin down.
Place the tube in a 95 °C heat block for 00:10:00 to denature the DNA.
Spin down and transfer the content to a 0.2 ml PCR tube.
Add 4 µL xGen Lockdown Probes and top up with water to a final volume of 15 µL.
Mix by pipetting.
Incubate the hybridization reaction at 47 °C in a thermocycler (lid at 57 °C) for 04:00:00 or overnight.

steps.title: Streptavidin Bead Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare and wash the Dynabeads M-270 Streptavidin.

substeps.instruction: Equilibrate Dynabeads M-270 Streptavidin (stored at 4 °C) to room temperature for 00:30:00.
Vortex beads for 00:00:15.
Aliquot 100 µL streptavidin beads per capture into a 1.5 ml tube.
Place in a magnetic rack, allow beads to separate, and discard supernatant.
Wash beads with 200 µL 1X Bead Wash Buffer per 100 µL beads; vortex for 00:00:10.
Place in magnetic rack, allow beads to separate, and discard supernatant.
Repeat the 1X Bead Wash Buffer wash.
Resuspend beads by adding 1X the original volume of 1X Bead Wash Buffer and vortexing.
Transfer 100 µL of resuspended beads into a new 0.2 ml tube for each capture reaction.
Place in magnetic rack, allow beads to separate, and discard supernatant.
Wash beads with 200 µL 1X Bead Wash Buffer per 100 µL beads; vortex for 00:00:10.
Place in magnetic rack, allow beads to separate, and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Target Capture
steps.instruction: Bind the hybridized DNA to the streptavidin beads.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the sample pool from the thermocycler (do not stop the program) into the tube containing prepared streptavidin beads.
Mix thoroughly by pipetting up and down 10 times.
Incubate in the thermal cycler at 47 °C (lid at 57 °C) for 00:45:00.
Vortex the tube for 00:00:03 every 15 minutes to keep beads in suspension.

steps.title: Post-Capture Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the beads to remove unbound DNA using stringent buffers.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL pre-heated 1X Wash Buffer I to the tube and vortex for 00:00:10.
Spin down and transfer the mixture to a fresh low-bind 1.5 ml tube.
Place in magnetic rack, allow beads to separate, and discard supernatant.
Add 200 µL preheated 1X Stringent Wash Buffer, mix by pipetting up and down 10 times, and incubate at 47 °C for 00:05:00.
Place in magnetic rack, allow beads to separate, and discard supernatant.
Repeat the 1X Stringent Wash Buffer wash.
Add 200 µL room temperature 1X Wash Buffer I and vortex for 00:02:00.
Add 200 µL preheated 1X Stringent Wash Buffer, mix by pipetting up and down 10 times, and incubate at 47 °C for 00:05:00.
Place in magnetic rack, allow beads to separate, and discard supernatant.
Place in magnetic rack again, allow beads to separate, and discard supernatant.
Add 200 µL room temperature 1X Wash Buffer II and vortex for 00:01:00.
Place in magnetic rack, allow beads to separate, and discard supernatant.
Add 200 µL room temperature 1X Wash Buffer III and vortex for 00:00:30.
Place in magnetic rack, allow beads to separate, and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Final Elution and Post-Capture PCR
steps.instruction: Resuspend the beads and perform the final PCR amplification.

substeps.instruction: Remove the tube from the magnetic rack and add 25 µL Nuclease-Free Water to resuspend the beads; mix by pipetting up and down 10 times (do not remove beads).
Thaw KAPA HiFi HotStart ReadyMix and Post-LM-PCR Oligos from SeqCap EZ Accessory Kits v2.
Set up and perform the PCR.
Perform Ampure XP clean-up with 0.68x ratio (or 0.8x for low-quality RNA) and elute into 20 µL.

steps.title: Final Quality Control
steps.instruction: Perform final quantification and size check of the captured pool.

substeps.instruction: Quantify the captured pool using Qubit and Tapestation.
Verify the Tapestation profile (expect a long tail depending on starting RNA quality).
